basic_info.description: Discover the epitome of modern luxury in this stunning 4BR, 3BA home nestled in the heart of Mission Dolores. This recently renovated & expanded property spans 3216 square feet of exquisite living space.    Step into a home where hardwood and polished concrete floors harmonize effortlessly leading you through the meopen kitchen, dining, and family room. The chef's kitchen is a masterpiece, featuring a butcher block island, built-in subzero refrigerator, 5-burner ILVE range, and marble countertops. Arched patio doors open to a beautifully landscaped backyard with an in-ground hot tub, ideal for indulging in the ultimate indoor/outdoor living experience.    Relax in the formal LR, where a gas fireplace and south-facing windows bathe the room in exceptional natural light. Upstairs, find four spacious BR's, two with walk-out balconies, offering a serene retreat. The spa-like bathroom featuring a soaking tub promises relaxation and tranquility.    The lower level boasts a massive media room, an office, a laundry room, and a full bath and direct access to a 1-car garage. Located in the vibrant Mission Dolores area this home enjoys a 100 transit score and a 98 walk score. Enjoy walking proximity to Whole Foods, Dolores Park, & the bustling Valencia Corridor and Castro neighborhoods
